payload.authorization: 2026-09-18 authorization covers preparation of this self-hashed contract only; it authorizes zero oracle calls and no scored launch

rules: pool lock is self-hashed and immutable before selection
query lock is self-hashed and immutable before reservation
every query candidate must resolve one-to-one into its pool lock
no regeneration, replacement or backfill after any score is observed

resume_may_not: change data, folds, candidates, seeds, features or controller policy
share outcomes across arms or tasks
checkpoint_resume.resume_policy: validate every identity and continue from the latest complete phase; a completed unit is idempotent, while an unresolved charged reservation blocks automatic continuation
snapshot_fields: SearchState archive, budget, rounds and history
ProgramValue weights, means, scales and observation count

payload.claim_boundary: A two-task warm development factorial over fixed root-conditioned candidate pools; it is not a full PMO benchmark, held-out PMO claim, iterative descendant-refinement result or IVG comparison

kill.action: retain the negative result and stop this route-prior/FiberControl revision; do not widen the lock or add calls post hoc
integrity: any candidate/query lock mutation or unbound oracle receipt
any accounting overflow, retry or fabricated score
kill.scientific: on both tasks, additive_route_fiber_control fails to exceed old_v0_fiber_control on AUC48 and additive_route_blind fails to exceed old_v0_blind on AUC48

durable_records: complete candidate pools and attempt statuses
FiberControl features, predictions, selected indices and fitted state

metrics.primary: native higher-is-better PMO top-ten trapezoid AUC through call 48, using pmo_top_ten_auc(frequency=1, finish=True)
secondary: proposal, exact-execution, oracle and wall time
validity, uniqueness, failures and candidate shortfalls

prelaunch_gates: all input and payload hashes verify
fold 0 excludes bioactivity and fold 2 excludes MPO with zero shared-lineage overlap
the pinned oracle environment and GSK3B asset verify without evaluation
pinned-environment v3 decision-equivalence passes on both pilot tasks
all score-blind candidate pools are complete, self-hashed and contain at least eight unique exact endpoints
candidate locks contain no score, task answer, route identity or teacher trace
synthetic query-ledger and interrupted-resume tests pass
implementation, contract, preflight and candidate locks are committed and the relevant worktree paths are clean
an exact scored authorization matching this contract has been recorded
prohibitions: no oracle or docking call under this preparation contract
no change to T4 or unrelated dirty files
no candidate inspection followed by pool regeneration
no extra task, arm, round, call, retry or backfill

all_required: additive_route_fiber_control exceeds old_v0_blind on AUC48 and best reward on both tasks
additive_route_fiber_control exceeds max(additive_route_blind, old_v0_fiber_control) by at least 0.02 AUC48 on at least one task
additive_route_fiber_control is no worse than that max by more than 0.01 AUC48 on the other task
at least one route-derived child improves its own parent on each task
promotion.meaning: promote to a separately contracted Dynamic archive/refinement qualification; do not claim full-PMO or IVG superiority

proposal_factor.candidate_shortfall_rule: if any locked round contains fewer than eight unique valid exact-replay endpoints, fail prelaunch before every oracle call
proposal_factor.cross_round_deduplication: canonical endpoint against initialization and every earlier lock within that task and proposal source
proposal_factor.parents: the same 16 immutable initialization molecules in every round
proposal_factor.scope_limit: proposal pools do not expand descendants; a positive result promotes the method to a separately contracted Dynamic archive integration

payload.required_agents_amendment: Authorize only the self-hashed PMO route-prior x FiberControl v1 pilot: GSK3B fold 0 and Perindopril MPO fold 2; four frozen arms; 48 charged calls per task/arm including 16 initialization calls; 384 total; zero retry; immutable score-blind pool locks; exact receipts and resume; no T4 change, broader PMO run or post-score candidate replacement.
payload.required_authorization_text: I authorize the scored PMO route-prior x FiberControl pilot exactly under configs/pmo_route_fiber_scored_pilot_v1.json, with at most 384 charged calls, zero retries, and no task or arm outcome sharing.
payload.scientific_question: Do split-clean route-derived executable proposals and within-task online FiberControl provide complementary PMO reward gains over unchanged Dynamic-v0 proposals and reward-blind selection?

fiber_control.training_data: only completed candidate transformations and native rewards from the same task and arm in earlier rounds

selection_factor.round_1_pairing: blind and FiberControl arms sharing a proposal source select the same eight candidate IDs because no transformation reward labels exist before round 1

split_discipline.runtime_fold_bundle: extract only the selected sanitized numeric fold checkpoint; the worker may not load other fold models or exact training traces
task_identity_used_only_for: selection of the preregistered held-family fold
